markers.label: Mid-Dec draft
markers.detail: Yentli, 1 Nov 2026: mid-December or so, so there is time to analyze the June run. 15 December is the mid-month marker, not a locked day.

markers.label: 18 Jan
markers.detail: Monday 18 Jan 2027, 5pm CET. Nominal date is 15 Jan; that is a Friday, so ESRF moves it to Monday.

tasks.title: HUB filing deadline is Monday 18 January 2027, 5pm CET
tasks.note: Checked 1 Nov 2026 on esrf.fr. HUB proposals and long-term proposals share the 15 January deadline at 5pm CET. If that date falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, it moves to the following Monday. 15 January 2027 is a Friday, so filing is Monday 18 January 2027 at 5pm CET. The year table on the site still lists the 2026 call.
tasks.source: esrf.fr/LTPProposal and the proposal deadlines page, checked 1 Nov 2026

tasks.title: Agree a balanced team for the HUB
tasks.note: Yentli, 1 Nov 2026: because this is a HUB, the team has to be discussed so it is balanced. Not locked, and no one is assigned to run that discussion. The spokesperson must be at an ESRF member or associate institution and cannot be an ESRF scientist. The list needs at least three independent groups. Jenna has not agreed to be spokesperson.

tasks.title: Ask ESRF management what a commitment looks like
tasks.note: A HUB has to be discussed with ESRF management and the beamline staff before it is filed. Asked 1 Nov 2026 whether Montserrat or Peter had been met. No answer yet.

tasks.title: Write the resource-commitment paragraph
tasks.note: This was the long-term proposal's resource paragraph. The application is now a HUB. Members commit to share knowledge, technology, beamtime data, and results before publication. Who writes that was not answered on 1 Nov 2026.
tasks.source: ESRF long-term proposal rules, copied 2 Oct 2026

tasks.title: Agree the aims on one page
tasks.note: The 15 Oct minutes asked Magda, Jenna, and Pegah to scope co-culture before drafting. That assignment is not confirmed. A January to February 2027 beamtime is not written in as committed work.

tasks.title: Name who drafts each section
tasks.note: The team writes. Who names the section drafters is not assigned. The spokesperson is not agreed.

tasks.title: Collect CVs, letters, and A-form material
tasks.note: Starts once the co-investigator list is locked.

tasks.title: Full draft for the team to read
tasks.note: Yentli, 1 Nov 2026: mid-December or so, so there is time to analyze the June run. 15 December is the mid-month marker, not a locked day. No one owns the draft.

tasks.title: Submit the HUB proposal and the A-forms
tasks.note: Yentli thinks Jenna will lead the next application through the HUB. Jenna has not agreed. The spokesperson files the HUB proposal, the first 6-month beamtime request, the A-forms, and later the annual reports. File by Monday 18 January 2027, 5pm CET.

tasks.title: Ask Sandra for the backup
tasks.note: Yentli, 1 Nov 2026: Sandra has been coordinating this beamtime. That is not an agreement that she leads LS-3634, and it is not the HUB spokesperson role. The backup is still needed. The report is filed under Sandra. Yentli is co-proposer.

tasks.title: Send the June images, counts, and Excel file
tasks.note: Images, cell and aggregate counts, and the Excel file for HEK, primary neurons, and SH-SY5Y. Not sent as of 1 Nov 2026. Yentli sent Sylvain a follow-up email.

tasks.title: Confirm backups and download instructions
tasks.note: Sandra holds the main copy and has been coordinating this beamtime. Sylvain was asked for a second copy on the beamline. Download instructions for the co-proposer are not confirmed. Yentli is co-proposer.

tasks.title: Analyze the June run for the proposal
tasks.note: The mid-December draft exists so this can happen first. Who does it is still open. Sandra was going to ask her student. Yentli was going to organize volunteers. Kenneth does not analyze.

tasks.title: Ask how the June results will be used
tasks.note: Ask this once the file is in hand. There is no date. Yentli is the person who already writes to the group.

tasks.title: Ask whether SOP GLAB-BIOH-001 was reviewed after 1 Sep 2026
tasks.note: The Aberdeen SOP was due for review on 1 Sep 2026. The 1 Nov reply said Sylvain filled out the ESRF safety declaration and Form A. It did not say this SOP was reviewed.
